authority: User-approved shared question layout plan and explicit implementation request

left: Course - current subtopic/activity, e.g. A Level Chemistry - Making Buffers
right: Existing question ID once, in original pink badge
header.source: Original IGCSE src/assets/shared-theme.css .header-question-code; original molecule/C3L6 masthead and quiet navy styling
header.after: Thin horizontal divider then question pane

pills.placement: Top of question pane above question title/instructions; compact noninteractive rounded outline with subtle translucent background and Comfortaa

remove: Course navigation row and activity sidebar on question screens
All visible Pause/Resume controls and pause notices
All question-screen timing displays or announcements
Duplicate question IDs and level labels
Post-question session summary including saved-result counts and routine revision status
Repeated activity headings; preserve actual question/subpart instructions
preserve: Existing specialist editor palettes, geometry, gestures and chemistry errata
Question IDs, banks, marking, mastery and timing mathematics
Read-only notices, C3L6 stage controls, assessment feedback, Check/Next
C3L6 Olympiad-only with no mastery/curriculum evidence
Existing statistics timing data; no statistics/import redesign
behaviour: Header metadata follows actual current question/course/subtopic, including revision and teacher selection
Back/eagle save and checkpoint through existing navigation guard; failed save blocks departure
Resume existing saved attempts automatically after safe load/save, including historical paused sessions; same identity, response and drawing; no away time
No accidental resume of prior selection on fresh launch or changed revision selection
Remove display-only clock state/interval; preserve real timing binding/checkpoints, idle/background/suspension rules and first-assessment cutoff
No timer/pause announcement in accessible UI; tracking verified through persisted evidence
Responsive long titles and controls, no page overflow

stages.outcome: Bounded audit/source and interface proposal with exact ownership
Implement, integrate, browser/render review and regression closure

delegation.retry: One clarified bounded retry; independent exception/root disposition for substantive failure
delegation.rationale: Single worker owns cohesive presentation; foreman owns host lifecycle integration and aggregate verification

validation: Original badge/header source fidelity; root desktop/mobile visual review
Both courses all three pill labels and Olympiad; one header ID only; no visible pause/timer/summary
Numeric, multipart/rubric, dot, other editor, teacher and C3L6 smoke
Revision title/level transitions and exact question ID/seed/answers on restoration
Historical paused sessions and current saved sessions automatically resume; fresh launch and changed selection isolated; StrictMode no duplicate evidence
